3d video me voice kaise dale:
Boss, 3D video mein voice daalne ke do mukhya tarike hain:
1. UE5 Sequencer mein Audio Track laga kar .wav/.mp3 voice file timeline par set karein.
2. 3D video render hone ke baad FFmpeg ya video editor se voice audio ko video ke saath merge karein taaki audio-video sync bilkul saaf rahe.
ue5 sequencer audio track: Boss, Unreal Engine 5 ke Sequencer mein `+ Track -> Audio Track` chunein aur apni narration ya dialogue audio file add karke camera/scene animation ke saath time match karein.
ffmpeg se video me voice kaise jode:
Boss, video aur voice audio ko mila kar final .mp4 banane ke liye FFmpeg command:
```bash
ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i voice.mp3 -c:v copy -c:a aac -shortest output_with_voice.mp4
```
3d video with voice workflow:
Boss, voice ke saath 3D video banane ka poora kram:
1. Script likhein aur voice (recording ya TTS jaise edge-tts) taiyar karein.
2. Voice ki timing ke hisab se UE5 mein scene/camera animation aur Sequencer set karein.
3. Video render karein aur audio merge karke final output banayein.
